title: lobelia polyphylla f. bracteosa
intro: Lobelia polyphylla f. bracteosa, commonly known as Indian tobacco or dwarf lobelia, is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its use as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues and as a treatment for coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia polyphylla f. bracteosa include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids such as lobeline, lobelanine, and norlobelanine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
